evidence: The Motatapu Track can be accessed from either end.
From Wānaka: Turn off the road to the Matukituki Valley at Glendhu Bay, 12 km from Wānaka. The Fern Burn carpark and track start are signposted on this road.
From Macetown, a 15 km 4WD road winds its way to Arrowtown.

doubts: The Fern Burn carpark is only described as signposted on the road to the Matukituki Valley, 12 km from Wanaka, after turning off at Glendhu Bay. No road-end feature is clearly that carpark (F1 is where the track meets Motatapu Road, a different road name), so the start ref is null. Arrowtown has no feature, so the end is null. The Arrow River route between Roses Hut and Macetown is a choice: following the river at normal levels (main way), or a sidling track with an unbridged Arrow River crossing when the river is high; the high-water crossing is not recorded as a way leg. The Arrow River crossings on Macetown Road are recorded as fords from the page's statement that trampers may negotiate the numerous river crossings with care. W2 is the Big Hill Track alternative for the final section, recorded as a whole-walk way from the same start; its 4-5 hr time covers only that alternative. Big Hill Track is not matched to the map's Big Hill Walkway (T1) since the names differ.
